The spigot.js browser client as an HTML dependency

Source: R/deps.R
spigot_dependency.Rd

spigot_app() attaches this to every page, so pages normally need nothing else. Use it directly only for a page that spigot_app() does not serve.

Usage

spigot_dependency(prefix = "/api")

Arguments

prefix

The API prefix, as given to spigot_app().

Value

An htmltools::htmlDependency().

Details

The script defines window.spigot:

  • spigot.ready: a promise that resolves with the session token once the Shiny session has started. Calls made earlier wait for it.

  • spigot.get(path, query, options), spigot.del(path, query, options), spigot.post(path, body, options), spigot.put(path, body, options), and spigot.request(method, path, options) with options query, body, headers and timeout (milliseconds). They resolve with the parsed JSON reply (text if the reply is not JSON, null if it is empty).

  • spigot.SpigotError: what they reject with, for a non-2xx reply or when no reply arrives. It has status (0 for a timeout or network failure), message (the reply's JSON error field when there is one) and body.

  • spigot.on(event, fn): calls fn(data, event) for each event that R pushes with spigot_emit() or spigot_broadcast(). Returns a function that removes the listener. spigot.off(event, fn) removes fn; spigot.off(event) removes every listener of event. A listener that throws does not stop the others; its error is still reported.

On a page below the top level, which spigot_app() gives a <base href>, the script also keeps plain clicks on href="#section" links on the page (see spigot_page()).

Paths are relative to the API, so spigot.get("items") and spigot.get("/items") both request api/items relative to the page. This keeps working when the app is served under a subpath. Every request carries the tab's session token in the X-Spigot-Session header. FormData, Blob, URLSearchParams and ArrayBuffer bodies are sent unchanged; any other body, strings included, is sent as JSON.

Examples

spigot_dependency()
#> List of 10
#>  $ name      : chr "spigot"
#>  $ version   : chr "0.0.0.9000"
#>  $ src       :List of 1
#>   ..$ file: chr "js"
#>  $ meta      : NULL
#>  $ script    :List of 2
#>   ..$ src        : chr "spigot.js"
#>   ..$ data-prefix: chr "/api"
#>  $ stylesheet: NULL
#>  $ head      : NULL
#>  $ attachment: NULL
#>  $ package   : chr "spigot"
#>  $ all_files : logi FALSE
#>  - attr(*, "class")= chr "html_dependency"
